task: Explore: build a cooperative-game cost-sharing tool (Shapley value, nucleolus, core) as a research-algorithm venture

errors.what: First nucleolus solved the primal stage LP (2^n rows) with Bland's rule: 62 s for 10 members; Dantzig pricing still 7-20 s.
errors.fix: Solve each stage's dual (n+1 rows); 10-45 ms, identical to the reference.

errors.what: Two test expectations were wrong (a group priced at 30 vs a split at 24 is correctly flagged; 'A,x' alone reads as a header).
errors.fix: Corrected the tests, not the engine.

doc_friction.issue: 'ships a real public dataset as its example' has no guidance for methods whose natural inputs (coalition prices, road distances) have no public dataset; used the Mishnah's claims as the real example and labelled the other two as made up.

deviations.why: Two of the three examples (shared road, three towns) are made-up numbers; no public dataset of coalition costs was available without paywalled papers.
deviations.did: Real public-domain example for the claims mode (Mishnah Ketubot 10:4, with its published answer as a test); the others are labelled 'made-up numbers' on the page, in example-data.mjs and data/SOURCE.md.
deviations.result: The real example doubles as the strongest test (Talmud rule and LP nucleolus agree with the Mishnah).

notes: Explore idea: cooperative game theory as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/cost-sharing-calculator); no venture README mentioned Shapley/nucleolus/core (1,387 searched). Shapley (exact, 14 members), nucleolus by Maschler-Peleg-Shapley sequential LPs solved through their duals with a hand-written two-phase simplex (10 members, 10-45 ms), SCRB/ENSC, core check naming the most-overcharged subgroup; road mode (Littlechild & Owen closed form, any size, prefix core check); claims mode (Talmud rule = nucleolus, random arrival = Shapley). Verified vs independent scipy HiGHS reference on 40 games (<=5e-12), Mishnah's three estates, glove game, textbook LP. DOIs checked against Crossref. Chromium at 1200/390 px: no console errors, no external requests. Local checks: run_venture_tests 38/38 pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output recorded below when finished.
